normalization.archive_incarnations: Only the opaque UUID suffix inside managed target archive-arn InputTemplate is normalized. The event and ingestion-time placeholders, paths map, ARN and template text remain asserted.
normalization.patterns: Generated archive managed-rule EventPattern JSON is compared semantically; customer DescribeArchive EventPattern text remains exact.
normalization.pagination: Each native returned NextToken is bound to the actual local SDK response token for subsequent requests. Token presence, per-page membership, repeat use, changed limit and filter misuse are retained. Native token bytes remain here as references, not local request tokens.
normalization.list_order: Archives and Rules are compared as page membership, not order. The source-filter list has a different captured order from the prefix list.
normalization.errors: Native error messages are retained as evidence, but the SDK runner asserts modeled codes, not human-readable wording.
normalization.timing: Immediate and later native reads agree on synchronous ENABLED admission, DISABLED force removal and ENABLED repair; replay scheduling timing is not part of this archive-control fixture.
